playoffFormats.label: 12 teams
playoffFormats.note: The five highest-ranked conference champions get automatic bids, Notre Dame is in if ranked in the top 12, the rest of the field is at-large, and the top four seeds get first-round byes.

playoffFormats.label: 24 teams
playoffFormats.note: The four Power 4 conference champions and the highest-ranked champion from the other conferences get automatic bids, 19 at-large teams complete the field, and the top eight seeds get first-round byes.
